resolved_intents.intent: Perform valid login with username and password
Search for product and add to cart

missing_methods.intent: Locate profile name element in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and return the profile name element in the dashboard header. This method should wait for the element to be present in the DOM and return the WebElement representing the profile name display.

missing_methods.intent: Wait for profile name to be visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the profile name element in the dashboard header to become visible. This method should use an explicit wait with the specified timeout (default 10 seconds) to ensure the profile name is displayed before proceeding. Should return True if visible within timeout, False otherwise.

missing_methods.intent: Assert displayed profile name matches expected user name
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Retrieve the displayed profile name from the dashboard header and assert that it matches the expected username. This method should get the text from the profile name element and perform an assertion to validate it equals the expected_username parameter. Should raise an assertion error if the names do not match.
